create_grpc_exception_interceptor: create an async gRPC server interceptor that catches exceptions and returns INTERNAL status codes
build_intercept_method: build an intercept method that wraps gRPC calls with try-except and logs errors
handle_runtime_error: handle RuntimeError in a gRPC interceptor by exiting the process immediately
clear_cuda_cache_on_error: clear the CUDA cache when a non-fatal exception occurs in a gRPC method
dump_stack_trace: dump a stack trace to the error message when the DUMP_STACK environment variable is set
